The Plains of Havoc, called the Fair Plains before the battles were fought (according to Oldrak), are located in the southern part of the Tibian Continent, south-west of Venore and south-east of Kazordoon, here (32747, 32258, 7). They were once the best hunting grounds for Paladins, to hunt Cyclopses at lower levels and Giant Spiders at higher levels. They are home to many assorted and dangerous creatures. There is a Temple where you can rest after fighting. Just east of this temple is the Abandoned Monastery. There is also the Necromant House, which has a portal that leads to The Void. Also, the Island of the Mists is a peaceful island reserved just for druids. The famous Knightwatch Tower can be found in the southern areas of PoH. West of the temple you can find the PoH Dragon Lair. Recently an area has been infected by a talking tree, the Demon Oak.
